title: Booking role play
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Local area, holiday and travel: travel and holidays (2.2, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 20 (Pupil PDF worksheet: booking role play)
intro: Lesson 20: Travel and accommodation: booking a room. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
- أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ غُرْفَةً لِشَخْصَيْنِ لِثَلَاثِ لَيَالٍ.
- هَلْ تُرِيدُ إِطْلَالَةً عَلَى البَحْرِ؟
- نَعَمْ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ. كَمِ السِّعْرُ؟
- مِئَةُ جُنَيْهٍ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ، مَعَ الفُطُورِ.

panels.title: Three time frames
points: Past: نَزَلْتُ فِي فُنْدُقٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنَ الحَرَمِ

questions.q: Say: I want to book a room for one person for two nights.
questions.a: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحْجِزَ غُرْفَةً لِشَخْصٍ وَاحِدٍ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ

questions.q: Write a 90-word description of a stay (real or imagined, e.g. near the Haram for 'Umrah) in the portal response box with past, present and future, then role-play a booking in a breakout pair.
questions.a: Three time frames, accommodation vocabulary, opinions; role play performed

questions.q: Extend: Group A (4AA1): write a three-sentence summary of your answer in other words and give the i'rab of one sentence. Group B (1AA0): say your answer aloud in a breakout and answer one follow-up question.
questions.a: Group A: accurate summary and i'rab; Group B: fluent spoken answer
A) ثَلَاثُ لَيَالٍ. لِثَلَاثِ لَيَالٍ: three nights.

questions.q: Think again: what makes a good place to stay?
questions.a: Clean, safe, near a masjid, good service.
